import json,collections
src=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
ans=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
ans[43]['note']='Initial unmasked word has an ambiguous final glyph; no additional hard sign confidently identified.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in ans: f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(src)==len(ans)
for r,a in zip(src,ans):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for a in ans for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Verified items:',len(ans),'order: correct; slot coverage: complete')
print('Slot calls:',dict(c),'total:',sum(c.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in ans))
